title: Conditional Statements in Python
overview: Conditional statements allow a program to make decisions based on whether a condition is True or False.

title: if else Statement
overview: The if else statement executes one block of code when a condition is true and another block when the condition is false.

example.title: if else Example

title: if elif else Statement
overview: The elif statement allows checking multiple conditions in a single decision-making structure.

example.title: elif Example

title: Nested Conditions
overview: Nested conditions are conditions placed inside another condition. They are useful when decisions depend on multiple levels.

example.title: Nested if Example

title: for Loop
overview: The for loop is used to iterate over a sequence like lists, strings, or ranges.

title: while Loop
overview: The while loop executes a block of code repeatedly as long as a condition remains true.

title: break and continue
overview: break stops a loop completely, while continue skips the current iteration and moves to the next one.

example.title: Loop Control Example

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned Python decision-making and looping concepts including if, elif, else, for loops, while loops, and loop control statements.
